title: Todo API spec
prompt:
Add the todo endpoints to backend/api/openapi.yaml (tag: todo) and regenerate internal/oas.

Schemas:
- Todo: {id: integer int64, title: string, done: boolean}, all required
- TodoCreate: {title: string, minLength 1, maxLength 200}, required
- TodoUpdate: {title?: string (minLength 1, maxLength 200), done?: boolean}

Operations (success response + the shared default Error response only; list error statuses in each description):
- listTodos   GET    /api/todos        -> 200 array of Todo
- createTodo  POST   /api/todos        body TodoCreate -> 201 Todo (400 invalid title)
- getTodo     GET    /api/todos/{id}   -> 200 Todo (404 unknown)
- updateTodo  PATCH  /api/todos/{id}   body TodoUpdate -> 200 Todo (400 invalid title, 404 unknown, 409 renaming a completed todo)
- deleteTodo  DELETE /api/todos/{id}   -> 204 (404 unknown)

title: Todo domain model and use cases (TDD)
prompt:
Build the todo bounded context's model test-first, in backend/internal/todo/{domain,app,adapter/memory}. No HTTP; another task builds the adapter against the UseCases interface below, in parallel with the API spec.

Domain (package domain):
- ID: int64 value type.
- Title: value object. NewTitle(s) trims whitespace; 1..200 characters (runes) after trimming, else ErrInvalidTitle.
- Todo aggregate: NewTodo(id ID, title Title) *Todo (open); ReconstituteTodo(id, title, done) for repositories; getters ID(), Title(), Done(); behaviors Rename(Title) error, Complete(), Reopen().
- Invariant: a completed todo cannot be renamed -> ErrTodoCompleted (reopen it first). Complete/Reopen are idempotent.
- Errors: ErrNotFound, ErrInvalidTitle, ErrTodoCompleted.
- Repository interface: NextID, Add, Get, List (ordered by ID), Update(ctx, id, fn func(*Todo) error), Delete.

Application (package app), inbound port:
  type UseCases interface {
    AddTodo(ctx context.Context, cmd AddTodo) (*domain.Todo, error)          // AddTodo{Title string}
    GetTodo(ctx context.Context, id domain.ID) (*domain.Todo, error)
    ListTodos(ctx context.Context) ([]*domain.Todo, error)
    ChangeTodo(ctx context.Context, cmd ChangeTodo) (*domain.Todo, error)    // ChangeTodo{ID domain.ID; Title *string; Done *bool}
    RemoveTodo(ctx context.Context, id domain.ID) error
  }
ChangeTodo applies, inside one repository Update: Done==false -> Reopen; Title set -> Rename; Done==true -> Complete. So {done:false,title:x} on a completed todo succeeds and {title:x} alone fails with ErrTodoCompleted. Service: NewService(repo domain.Repository) *Service.

Memory adapter (package memory): NewRepository() implementing domain.Repository; IDs start at 1; mutex-guarded; stores copies.

title: Logging and CORS middleware
prompt:
Create package middleware in backend/internal/middleware, test-first:
- func Logger(next http.Handler) http.Handler: logs method, path, status and duration via log/slog (wrap ResponseWriter to capture status).
- func CORS(allowedOrigin string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler: sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin/Methods/Headers and answers OPTIONS preflight with 204.
- func Chain(h http.Handler, mws ...func(http.Handler) http.Handler) http.Handler, first = outermost.
Do NOT wire it into the server; another task does that.

title: Todo HTTP adapter and wiring
prompt:
Implement backend/internal/todo/adapter/httpapi: type TodoHandler with NewTodoHandler(uc app.UseCases) *TodoHandler, implementing listTodos, createTodo, getTodo, updateTodo and deleteTodo with the exact signatures from internal/oas/oas_server_gen.go. Map oas <-> domain/app types; map errors in one mapError: ErrInvalidTitle -> 400, ErrNotFound -> 404, ErrTodoCompleted -> 409 (as *oas.ErrorStatusCode with a readable message); anything else is returned unchanged (500). Test the adapter test-first with a fake app.UseCases.

Then wire it: embed *httpapi.TodoHandler in handler.Handler, and in bootstrap.New() build memory.NewRepository() -> app.NewService -> httpapi.NewTodoHandler.

title: Wire middleware into the server
prompt: In backend/internal/server/server.go, wrap the ogen server with middleware.Chain(srv, middleware.Logger, middleware.CORS(origin)), where origin comes from the CORS_ORIGIN env var (default http://localhost:5173). Keep server.New's signature. Add a test in server_test.go that an OPTIONS preflight on /api/health returns 204 with the CORS headers, and keep the existing tests passing.

title: End-to-end todo tests
prompt: Write backend/e2e/todo_test.go using newClient(t) and the generated oas.Client: full lifecycle (add, list, rename, complete, reopen, remove), list starts empty, title validation (empty, whitespace-only, 200 vs 201 characters), renaming a completed todo -> 409, reopening and renaming in one update succeeds, 404s for unknown IDs, and that every error body matches {"error": string}. Use raw net/http requests for malformed JSON.

title: Backend documentation
prompt: Write docs/backend.md: the architecture (hexagon layers, dependency rules, bootstrap), the todo bounded context (glossary, aggregate rules, use cases), how to run it (docker compose up; or go run ./cmd/server with STORAGE=memory|mongo, MONGO_URI, MONGO_DB, PORT, CORS_ORIGIN), every endpoint with curl examples and responses, the error format, and the spec -> go generate -> test-first implementation workflow.

title: Todo MongoDB repository
prompt:
Add MongoDB storage for the todo context, test-first.

1. backend/internal/todo/adapter/repotest: move the repository contract out of the memory adapter's tests into func Run(t *testing.T, newRepo func(t *testing.T) domain.Repository). Cover: NextID starts at 1 and increases, Add/Get round trip, Get/Update/Delete of unknown IDs -> domain.ErrNotFound, List ordered by ID (empty -> empty slice), Update applies fn atomically and persists, an fn error aborts the update, returned aggregates are copies. Make the memory tests call repotest.Run.
2. backend/internal/todo/adapter/mongodb: Repository implementing domain.Repository on collection "todos" (document {_id int64, title string, done bool, version int64}), counters collection for NextID, optimistic concurrency in Update (retry on version conflict). Its test calls repotest.Run against a fresh database per test (test_<random>, dropped in t.Cleanup), and calls t.Skip unless MONGO_TEST_URI is set.
3. backend/internal/bootstrap: when storage is mongo, use todomongodb.NewRepository(db) instead of the memory repository (remove the `_ = db` placeholder).

title: Security review: todo API spec
prompt: Review the todo endpoints in backend/api/openapi.yaml before they are implemented: input bounds (lengths, numeric ranges), the unbounded listTodos response (pagination), exposed fields, and whether error statuses leak information. Write docs/security/T-009-spec-review.md and propose spec fixes (role api) as follow-up tasks.

title: Security review: todo context, HTTP layer and infrastructure
prompt: Threat-model and review the implemented todo context end to end: the httpapi adapter (error mapping, no leaked internals), the MongoDB repository (operator injection, timeouts, unbounded queries), the server (body size limits, timeouts, CORS, security headers, rate limiting), and the infrastructure (docker-compose.yml, backend/Dockerfile, .dockerignore). Fix infrastructure issues directly; for code issues add security regression tests in backend/e2e/security_*_test.go (skipped until fixed) and propose follow-up tasks. Write docs/security/T-010-hardening-review.md.
